correctness.rationale: The coefficient extraction is exact from the Motzkin generating function. All j>=k convolution terms vanish 3-adically. Kummer carry counting gives v3(C_{3^k-j-2})>=k-j for every 1<=j<k, including special j=1,2,3 and the high-digit argument for j>=4; hence all j>=1 terms vanish modulo 3^k. Lucas and the exact Catalan identity give the surviving j=0 term as -3^(k-1) mod 3^k, proving v3=k-1. The finite arithmetic verification is not the proof.

value.rationale: This directly resolves an explicitly posed and motivated unboundedness question, not an arbitrary finite slice: it produces exact, arbitrarily large valuations at natural ternary-radix indices. The carry mechanism is structural and infinitely uniform. The 3-regularity problem is expressly left open.
